    "# Loading failures\n",
    "\n",
    "*Diagnosing and inspecting hardware platform initialization errors in OpenMM.*\n",
    "\n",
    "The function {func}`molsysmt.third_party.openmm.platforms.loading_failures` reports underlying driver incompatibilities, missing shared libraries, or CUDA loading errors if OpenMM hardware accelerator platforms fail to load.\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n",
    "\n",
